title: N2 jmap-server: PushSubscriptionBackend + /get
description: Caller-scoped PushSubscriptionBackend trait; PushSubscription/get handler (no accountId/state; url and keys never returned; forbidden if requested); register_push_subscription_handlers; in-module mock backend. See JMAP-nbk3 design field (approved plan) for scope, acceptance and quoted RFC/draft lines.
notes:
Regression test (attempt 1): crate-jmap-server/tests/push_subscription_get.rs (3 tokio tests, RFC 8620 7.2.1/7.2.3 oracles). Fails at HEAD with E0432: PushSubscriptionBackend, StoredPushSubscription, register_push_subscription_handlers not yet exported. Mock implements only list_push_subscriptions and builds StoredPushSubscription by struct literal {subscription, expected_code}.
Implemented (uncommitted): crate-jmap-server/src/push.rs (StoredPushSubscription w/ redacting Debug, PushSubscriptionBackend::list_push_subscriptions only - N3 adds create/update/destroy, register_push_subscription_handlers, private handler); lib.rs re-exports + PushSubscription re-export; README. ids cap is a fixed 500 (ponytail:) since max_objects_in_get is per-account. No in-module mock added: tests/push_subscription_get.rs mock covers N2 acceptance. Follow-up JMAP-yt1w.39 (invalid property -> invalidArguments). Gates green.
Done in bf138213: tests get_null_ids_matches_rfc_example_without_account_id_state_url_or_keys, get_explicitly_requesting_url_or_keys_is_forbidden, get_returns_only_subscriptions_of_the_requesting_credentials; changed existing tests: none
